hypotheses.D1_hybrid128_intermediate_fidelity: Hybrid-128 has median KL at most 0.02 and CE increase at most 0.03 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D2_hybrid256_high_fidelity: Hybrid-256 has median KL at most 0.01 and CE increase at most 0.015 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D3_hybrid_matched_width_advantage: Hybrid bases have lower median KL than state-only bases at every matched dimension on every corpus.
hypotheses.D4_ood_threshold_by_256: Every corpus reaches median KL at most 0.01 at some tested hybrid dimension no larger than 256.
hypotheses.D5_hybrid256_top1: Hybrid-256 preserves the native top token on at least 90% of positions for every corpus.
